title: Compact and inspect continuity
steps: Open the compaction plan. Inspect retained facts: contract version, candidate identity, policy version, pending operations and evidence refs.
Inspect the summary model route, egress and cost implications.
Request a new durable compact operation with an expected context/task revision.
Preserve pending approvals and unknown external-effect state through compaction.
After commit, inspect before/after basis, measured reduction and the new summary version.
Keep required contract, candidate identity and unresolved obligations reachable and active.
forbidden_fake_states: A compacted transcript view shown as runtime context reduction
measured reduction fabricated from an estimate
complete_when: required contract, candidate identity and unresolved obligations remain reachable and active (p.184).
traceability: p.184; controls K-01..K-04, C-12, I-11, V-07; acceptance A15.
